# Migration to 0.1.0

Initial adoption vendors a self-contained framework. Existing applications should add the minimal manifest and selected packages incrementally. Do not rewrite user documents. React replaces SwiftUI for new implementations; the original SwiftUI source remains in archive/swiftui-v0. Updates refuse modified managed files and keep the previous snapshot for recovery.

## Personal standard adoption

For the current 0.1.0 source snapshot, add `standards` to `garden.json`:

```json
{"profile":"garden-personal/1","exceptions":[]}
```

Read `contracts/framework/README.md` (under `vendor/garden` in adopted apps).
Replace app-owned pane toggles/search launchers with the standard `GAppShell`
controls, supply localized toggle labels, and connect controlled pane setters.
Keep titlebar slots for actual history/context. Remove app branding and filler
page subtitles. If a different toolbar is necessary, record `shell.layout` and
use explicit custom mode with replacement controls.

Use `GDocumentEditor` for complete PDC documents and `GDocumentProperties` for
standalone metadata inspectors. Existing document sources do not change merely
because these component APIs change. The desktop sample is still in-memory;
persistence needs the host's guarded storage and vault capabilities.

Run `sync`, `doctor`, build/tests and the changed running-app paths. The ergonomic
CLI now compares snapshot contents as well as version numbers: `garden update`
can apply this changed development snapshot at the same version, provided the
current managed snapshot has no local drift. `garden init` prepares an existing
non-Garden app; the Garden plugin skill completes its app-specific integration.
Use `--dry-run` to inspect changes before applying them.
